# Satyam Patel - Portfolio

> Official developer portfolio of Satyam Patel, Frontend Developer and Second-Year B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) student at Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU), Lucknow, India.

Passionate about frontend development, MERN stack, Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), and Machine Learning. Actively building projects and participating in hackathons like Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2025).
